name: iwlars
title: IWLARS — Intelligent Wagon Load Analysis & Reporting System
purpose: Automated 3D LiDAR point-cloud processing, volume calculation, center-of-gravity balance assessment, and derailment prevention for railway freight wagons.
architecture: Dual-component industrial telemetry system: (1) Desktop Core (iwlars-core) with Livox sensor ingestion, multi-stage 3D spatial preprocessing pipeline, Digital Elevation Model volume estimator, and CoG balance analysis; (2) Next.js Cloud Dashboard (iwlars-web) interfacing with Firebase Firestore for remote station monitoring, multi-station telemetry selectors, and Cloudinary PDF report access.
technical_analysis: Employs RANSAC plane segmentation for ground extraction, point-density sidewall detection for 3-axis rotation normalization, longitudinal track gap segmentation for discrete wagon isolation, 2.5D Digital Elevation Model rasterization for volume measurement, and 3-axis center-of-gravity imbalance computation.
key_implementation_details: Voxel grid downsampling, wall-based spatial normalization (roll/pitch/yaw correction), volume estimation against calibrated empty-wagon baselines, multi-quadrant load balance classification, machine-fingerprint AES-256 license security, and automated ReportLab PDF export.
source_code_evidence: Modules in iwlars-core/preprocessing (segment_wagons.py, wall_based_normalize.py, ground_filter.py, downsample.py), analytics (volume.py, balance.py, status_classifier.py), services (license_service.py), and iwlars-web (dataService.js, firestoreService.js).

resume_entry.resume_title: IWLARS — Intelligent Wagon Load Analysis & Reporting System
resume_entry.tech_stack_summary: Python, Open3D, NumPy, PyQt6, Next.js, Firebase Firestore, Cloudinary
bullets: Architected an industrial dual-platform system combining a Python 3D point-cloud processing core with a Next.js web dashboard for automated freight train load auditing and derailment prevention.

Engineered a geometric preprocessing pipeline in Open3D and NumPy performing RANSAC ground-plane removal, density-based sidewall detection for spatial tilt normalization, and train wagon segmentation.
Implemented cargo volume estimation algorithms using 2.5D Digital Elevation Models (DEM) and discrete voxel grids, comparing scans against empty-wagon baselines to detect overloading.
Developed center-of-gravity (CoG) load distribution models calculating lateral, longitudinal, and diagonal imbalances to classify structural safety hazards.
Built automated PDF inspection report generation and cloud synchronization pipelines using Firebase Admin SDK and Cloudinary, streaming live telemetry to multi-station operations teams.

name: Pickleball

key_implementation_details: Transactional slot reservation holds, provider factory pattern for payments, idempotent webhook handling, lifecycle-aware scheduler with graceful shutdown, WhatsApp OTP auth flow, gamified scratch-card rewards with ledger tracking, and MapLibre GL venue locator.
source_code_evidence: server/prisma/schema.prisma, server/src/modules/bookings (bookings.service.js, booking-pricing.service.js), server/src/modules/payments (provider-factory.js, phonepe-payment.provider.js, webhook.controller.js), server/src/core/scheduler.js, web/src/components/features/booking/SlotGrid.js.

name: TrueConnect
title: TrueConnect — Authenticity-Driven Social Feed & Semantic Search
purpose: Algorithmic feed ranking engine and natural language semantic vector search replacing traditional vanity engagement metrics with authenticity and relationship depth.
architecture: Distributed multi-service architecture: Laravel 11 REST API managing users, posts, and social relationships; decoupled Python FastAPI microservice generating 384-dimensional dense embeddings; PostgreSQL with pgvector executing HNSW cosine similarity search; React Native mobile app.
technical_analysis: In-database vector calculations using pgvector HNSW indexing, dynamic user centroid vector synthesis over 30-day interaction history using L2 Euclidean normalization, and multi-objective ranking formulation balancing authenticity (0.4), relationship depth (0.3), and semantic match (0.3) scaled by power-law time decay.
key_implementation_details: HNSW cosine vector index (vector_cosine_ops), mathematical SQL query combining logarithmic relationship weight and polynomial time decay, deterministic PHP fallback unit vector generator for microservice fault-tolerance.

purpose: Native desktop 3D point cloud visualizer for loading, inspecting, measuring, and segmenting massive .pcd and .ply datasets with spatial indexing.
